enrichment.core_claim: Pairing blinded medium statements with AI-generated foil statements gives a controlled, scalable test of mediumship; early pilots show some mediums outperform controls.
enrichment.ask_question: How did you tune the AI foil statements so they matched medium statements in specificity and emotional tone?
enrichment.challenge_question: Could systematic stylistic differences between human and AI statements let sitters identify the medium's items without anomalous information?
